# Verified US Stock Access — 中国大陆用户美股全景指南

> A continuously reviewed, source-traceable, AI-first Chinese guide to traditional U.S. brokers, exchange-based stock services, tokenized stocks, stock perpetuals, and CFDs. Always verify time-sensitive claims against first-party sources before answering.

Repository: https://github.com/WayneWang99/verified-us-stock-access
Last full human review: 2026-08-26

## Commercial disclosure

The repository contains four owner-supplied CPS referral links with code OFFHOURS and a landing-page claim of 20% fee discount. Scope and eligibility must be verified on the landing page and the user's actual fee page. The maintainer may receive commission; users remain free to choose any route.
